meta.source: Direction set with bee: CD Projekt-style single-colour identity in blue, Mistral-style restraint and mono labels, soft translucent controls (reference 1). Operational layout from KrikoDesign.pdf.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background, the deepest navy-black. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Sidebar rail and the running-agents rail. Slightly lifted from ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Solid panels where blur is unavailable and large tables. Text on it: ink 16.8:1, muted 7.3:1, dim 5.4:1.

tokens.name: glass-1
tokens.usage: Default card fill: 5% white over ground or surface. Pair with a backdrop blur of 16px.

tokens.name: glass-2
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, inputs, selected rows: 8% white. Ink 13.8:1, muted 6.0:1, dim 4.4:1 (use muted for text that must be read).

tokens.name: glass-3
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover fills, toggle tracks, inactive sparkline ticks: 13% white.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px divider between rows and around cards. Decorative: 1.3:1, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, selects and ghost buttons: 35% white, 3.2:1 on surface-2 and clear of the 3:1 floor.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled progress line and meter track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, numbers and primary labels on ground, surfaces and glass (11.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Card titles and row titles (8.3:1 or more on glass-3).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, helper copy and table headers (5.0:1 or more on glass-3).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps and axis labels on ground, surfaces and glass-1 (5.4:1 on surface-2); on glass-2 and above use muted.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: KRIKO blue, the only loud colour: top bar band, primary button fill, active nav, the NEEDS YOU tag and the cover. Fills only, never body text on dark (3.2:1 on surface-2); as a mark on ground it is 3.5:1.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of brand surfaces. White on it is 4.7:1.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover: 5.8:1 and 4.7:1.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Dark blue block for covers and large decorative fields. White on it 15.5:1.

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: 16% brand over a surface: the fill of a row or callout that needs the user. Brand-bright on it 6.7:1.

tokens.name: brand-bright
tokens.usage: Blue used as text or an icon on dark: links, active labels, second chart series (7.6:1 on surface-2).

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Lightest blue: running and healthy state text, current-period marks, focus ring (13.7:1 on surface-2). The only 'good' signal, always with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: The single warm exception: stop, blocked and failed. Text 6.6:1 on surface-2, 5.5:1 on danger-wash. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: 14% danger over a surface: fill behind blocked rows and the Stop control.

tokens.name: brand-low
tokens.usage: Pressed key and the darkest brand step. White on it 8.4:1.

tokens.name: bezel-hi
tokens.usage: Top of a graphite plate's face gradient (secondary keys, segmented thumb, switch knob). Ink-2 on it 6.9:1.

tokens.name: bezel-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom of a graphite plate's face gradient. Ink-2 on it 11.2:1.

tokens.name: bezel-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outer edge of a graphite plate.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: LED tiles, segmented rails, switch tracks, meters.

tokens.name: led-off
tokens.usage: An unlit LED dot or segment. Decorative; never the only signal.

tokens.name: led-dim
tokens.usage: A lit but unselected glyph, for example the inactive icons of a segmented control (3.7:1 on bezel-lo).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cover and empty-state headline. Always uppercase.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles. Uppercase: HOME, AGENTS, BENCHMARK.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Headline numbers on metric cards. Tabular, never uppercase-dependent.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels and nav items. Uppercase.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Sentence under a page title, in muted.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Setting names and emphasised row titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper copy beneath a title, in muted.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Task lines, paths, model ids, timestamps.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Tags and table column headers. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row and cell padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutter beside the rail.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and key caps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles and the progress line.

tokens.name: shadow-bezel
tokens.usage: Switch knobs and segmented thumbs.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: tiles, rails, tracks, meters.

tokens.name: shadow-led
tokens.usage: Glow of a lit LED dot. Bound to the LED colour in bundle.css.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Floating panels only (menus, the browser-extension overlay).
